about: Build boxes for tools/devbox-pool.py, in order of preference. Copy this file to devbox-settings.json (gitignored: it is machine-local) and edit it. A box runs up to `slots` jobs at once; slot 0 is `lock` itself, the same file the agents' `flock` commands take, and slot N is `lock` + `.N`. `round_marker` exists while a validation round runs there; ordinary jobs skip such a box. `build_jobs`, when set, is exported as CT_BUILD_JOBS (tools/remote-build.sh's -j) so concurrent slots share the cores instead of each taking all of them; tests still use every core. `server` is the infra helper that starts the box (paths are relative to this file).

boxes.name: devbox-aws
boxes.note: c7a.8xlarge, 32 Zen 4 cores, 61 GiB: four slots of 8 build jobs (about 12 GB each at peak); four uncapped builds once ran a 32 GiB box out of memory

boxes.name: devbox-gcp
boxes.note: t2d-standard-16, 16 Zen 3 cores without SMT, 64 GB: two slots of 8 build jobs

boxes.name: devbox
boxes.note: 8 vCPU = 4 cores with SMT, 32 GiB: one job
